scope: Earth 1.5.4 physical generation in strict Planet LAN mode
snapshotBoundary: roomId + revision; frame identity and fixed quantum are per anchor/job

physicalInputs.source: Mapterhorn tiles and contextual ground filtering
physicalInputs.pin: decoded float32 tile after ground filtering, keyed by z/x/y
physicalInputs.strictFailure: AWS failover, missing tile, partial ground filter or unreadable pin rejects the job

physicalInputs.source: Overture vector cell NPZ and WorldCover/CHM raster cell NPZ
physicalInputs.pin: complete NPZ bytes per release/layer/z/x/y; bypass writable mirror and decoded LRU; a vector cell with zero features needs a verified Overture release-index/query coverage marker, with the collection rechecked remotely once per reader; old unverified empty caches are rebuilt before pinning; landcover without source files is rejected

physicalInputs.source: pinned buildings and roads map layers
physicalInputs.pin: derived store disabled in LAN; recalculate from pinned map layers

physicalInputs.source: OurAirports airports.csv and runways.csv from one complete generation
physicalInputs.pin: both CSV byte streams in one atomic room pin; parse before admission

physicalInputs.source: pinned water map layers, pinned DEM, NOAA bathymetry response
physicalInputs.pin: complete derived depth/level/outline raster per cell; missing bathymetry rejects admission
consumers: carved terrain height and ground material

physicalInputs.source: pinned canopy/landcover/buildings/roads/water/land use/land map layers and DEM
physicalInputs.pin: complete derived Items per cell; incomplete forest/field reads or DEM slope reject admission
consumers: tree, shrub and rock collision shapes

physicalInputs.source: per-anchor ENU origin, 2 m lattice, fixed frame quantum, physical CLI options and generator/native versions
physicalInputs.pin: room config fingerprint includes exact Python producer hashes and native extension version/hash; per-job frame ID/epoch; quantum overflow rejects the block

activation: Server.activate_world requires no preview anchors, terrain/tile artifacts or in-flight jobs and no external road/far worker pools; Task 5 binds a PhysicsFrame to each connection before prepare_anchor. Recreate workers after draining preview jobs or start a fresh backend.
knownLimits: Terrain worldManifest covers per-job pinned sources and actual heightmap/TER/mask bytes; road, building, water and vegetation artifact manifests still need output-level wiring in Task 5/6.
Task 5/6 must propagate and enforce the backend/native fingerprint plus client/game fingerprints in the room descriptor before two peers agree.
A real two-game collision overlap and long-travel handoff have not been measured.
